title_en: Can freedom and safety coexist?
title_zh: 自由和安全能共存吗？

follow_ups.en: Where in life did you pick one over the other?
follow_ups.zh: 你在生活里什么时候选过其中一个？

title_en: Does honesty make you weaker or stronger?
title_zh: 诚实让你更脆弱，还是更强？

follow_ups.en: Tell about one truth that cost you something.
follow_ups.zh: 说一件「说真话让你付出代价」的事。

title_en: Can two people fully understand each other?
title_zh: 两个人能完全理解彼此吗？

follow_ups.en: Who understands you best — and what's still missing?
follow_ups.zh: 谁最懂你？还有什么没被懂到？

title_en: Do happiness and success need the same schedule?
title_zh: 快乐和成功一定要抢同一张时间表吗？

follow_ups.en: When were you happy without achieving anything?
follow_ups.zh: 什么时候你很开心，却和「成就」无关？

title_en: Is rest lazy — or necessary?
title_zh: 休息是懒，还是必须？

follow_ups.en: When did you last stop without a reason?
follow_ups.zh: 你上次「没理由地停下来」是什么时候？

title_en: Can you love someone and still wish they were different?
title_zh: 你能爱一个人，又希望 Ta 有点不一样吗？

follow_ups.en: Who comes to mind first?
follow_ups.zh: 你第一个想到谁？

title_en: What if all lies disappeared tomorrow?
title_zh: 如果明天起世上没有谎言？

follow_ups.en: Would the world be kinder or crueler?
follow_ups.zh: 世界会更温柔，还是更残酷？

title_en: What if people stopped aging at 30?
title_zh: 如果人在 30 岁停止变老？

follow_ups.en: What would you stop putting off?
follow_ups.zh: 你还会拖延什么？

title_en: What if we could share dreams like songs?
title_zh: 如果梦可以像歌单一样分享？

follow_ups.en: What would you hide?
follow_ups.zh: 你会藏起什么？

title_en: Would you delete one memory — if it were safe?
title_zh: 若能安全删除一段记忆，你会删吗？

follow_ups.en: What kind of memory — sweet, awkward, or both?
follow_ups.zh: 什么样的记忆：甜的、尬的，还是都有？

title_en: What if the internet went off for a year?
title_zh: 如果互联网断一整年？

follow_ups.en: What would you miss first? What would return?
follow_ups.zh: 最先想念什么？什么会回到你生活里？

title_en: If AI understood you better than your best friend, would friendships feel lighter or lonelier?
title_zh: 若 AI 比挚友更懂你，友情会更轻松还是更孤独？

follow_ups.en: What do humans still do better?
follow_ups.zh: 人还比机器强在哪？

title_en: When did you first feel like an adult?
title_zh: 你第一次觉得自己「像大人」是什么时候？

follow_ups.en: Was it a moment others saw too?
follow_ups.zh: 别人也看出来了吗？

title_en: What's one sentence you've never said out loud?
title_zh: 有没有一句话，你一直没说出口？

follow_ups.en: What stopped you — fear, timing, or kindness?
follow_ups.zh: 是什么拦住了你：害怕、时机，还是善意？

title_en: When were you last simply happy?
title_zh: 你上次「单纯的开心」是什么时候？

follow_ups.en: What did that day sound and look like?
follow_ups.zh: 那天听起来、看起来什么样？

title_en: If you could keep only one memory, which one?
title_zh: 如果只能留一段记忆，你留哪一段？

follow_ups.en: Why that one?
follow_ups.zh: 为什么是它？

title_en: What do people misunderstand about you?
title_zh: 别人容易误会你什么？

follow_ups.en: Is correcting them worth the energy?
follow_ups.zh: 解释清楚值得花力气吗？

title_en: Who are you becoming when no one grades you?
title_zh: 没人打分的时候，你在变成什么样的人？

follow_ups.en: What habit is training that person?
follow_ups.zh: 哪个习惯在塑造 Ta？

title_en: Stability or passion — which leans for the next five years?
title_zh: 接下来五年，你更倾向稳定还是热爱？

follow_ups.en: Has your answer changed since you were younger?
follow_ups.zh: 答案和年轻时比变了吗？

title_en: Is kindness a skill or a choice?
title_zh: 善良是练出来的，还是一次次选出来的？

follow_ups.en: When has kindness felt expensive?
follow_ups.zh: 什么时候善良很贵？

title_en: Fit in — or stay your shape?
title_zh: 融入环境，还是保留自己的形状？

follow_ups.en: Where have you paid a price for either?
follow_ups.zh: 你为哪一边付过代价？

title_en: In love: heat — or slow warmth?
title_zh: 爱情里，你要热烈，还是细水长流的安全感？

follow_ups.en: What did you want at 20? What about now?
follow_ups.zh: 二十岁时要什么？现在呢？

title_en: Walk away from good-but-wrong — or stay and fix it?
title_zh: 离开「好但不对」的东西，还是留下修补？

follow_ups.en: A fork where you still wonder.
follow_ups.zh: 说一个你至今还在想的岔路口。

title_en: If being 'good' shrinks you, is it still good?
title_zh: 若「做好人」让你变小，还算好吗？

follow_ups.en: Where's the line between generous and erased?
follow_ups.zh: 慷慨和被抹掉，界线在哪？

title_en: Why are we so good at performing ourselves?
title_zh: 为什么人这么擅长「演自己」？

follow_ups.en: Where do you perform most — online, work, or home?
follow_ups.zh: 你在哪演得最多：线上、工作，还是家里？

title_en: Why is the mind louder at night?
title_zh: 为什么夜里脑子更吵？

follow_ups.en: What topic visits you after midnight?
follow_ups.zh: 半夜最常来找你的是什么念头？

title_en: Do feeds connect us — or keep us alone?
title_zh: 信息流是在连接人，还是让人一直一个人？

follow_ups.en: When did you last feel seen — online vs in a room?
follow_ups.zh: 上次「被看见」是在网上，还是在真人面前？

title_en: Why open the same chat again and again?
title_zh: 为什么总反复点开同一个聊天框？

follow_ups.en: Hope, anxiety, or boredom?
follow_ups.zh: 是希望、焦虑，还是无聊？

title_en: Why does 'busy' sound like a personality?
title_zh: 为什么「忙」听起来像一种人设？

follow_ups.en: Who benefits from your hurry?
follow_ups.zh: 谁从你的「赶」里受益？

title_en: Why vent to strangers but not ask family for help?
title_zh: 为什么对陌生人吐槽容易，向亲人求助却难？

follow_ups.en: What does asking for help feel like in your body?
follow_ups.zh: 「求助」在你身体里是什么感觉？

title_en: If you knew life's ending tone — not details — would small moments still matter?
title_zh: 若你早知道人生结局的「调子」（不是细节），小事还重要吗？

follow_ups.en: Bigger swings or smaller joys?
follow_ups.zh: 你会追大起大落，还是珍惜小确幸？

title_en: Is a life without pain still full?
title_zh: 没有痛苦的人生还算完整吗？

follow_ups.en: Any pain that changed you for the better?
follow_ups.zh: 有没有哪种痛反而把你变好了？

title_en: Do we choose our next thought?
title_zh: 下一个念头，是我们选的吗？

follow_ups.en: When did you last surprise yourself?
follow_ups.zh: 你上次被自己吓一跳是什么时候？

title_en: If 'real' is what we agree on, what happens when groups stop overlapping?
title_zh: 若「真实」靠共识，圈子不重叠时真相会怎样？

follow_ups.en: Where do you feel sure about what's real?
follow_ups.zh: 你在哪件事上对「什么是真的」最有把握？

title_en: Why do we miss pain — once it's far away?
title_zh: 痛走远了，人为什么还会想念？

follow_ups.en: Something you swore you'd never miss?
follow_ups.zh: 有没有你发誓不会怀念、后来却怀念的？

title_en: Live one week twice — what would you change the second time?
title_zh: 同一周活两遍，第二遍你会改什么？

follow_ups.en: More truth — or more silence?
follow_ups.zh: 更多真话，还是更多沉默？

title_en: Will we sacrifice today for a future we won't see?
title_zh: 人会为看不见的未来牺牲现在的舒服吗？

follow_ups.en: What have you already given up for later?
follow_ups.zh: 你已经为「以后」放弃过什么？

title_en: Parallel life — what's the first check that you're still you?
title_zh: 平行人生里，你第一件事查什么来确认「还是我自己」？

follow_ups.en: Memory, relationships, or habits?
follow_ups.zh: 靠记忆、关系，还是习惯？

title_en: Can you protect someone without teaching them they need permission to risk?
title_zh: 保护一个人，会不会不小心让 Ta 觉得「冒险要先获准」？

follow_ups.en: Who protected you well — or too much?
follow_ups.zh: 谁保护得好？谁保护得过头？

title_en: Sixty seconds of your thoughts — strangers pick the minute. How do you spend the month before?
title_zh: 陌生人随机听你想 60 秒——你会怎么过之前那一个月？

follow_ups.en: Mean thoughts or scared thoughts — which is worse to expose?
follow_ups.zh: 被听到「坏念头」还是「怕的念头」，哪个更糟？

title_en: What did you almost become?
title_zh: 你差点成了谁？

follow_ups.en: Job, city, or version of you?
follow_ups.zh: 工作、城市，还是某一种你？

title_en: Why can a crowded room feel lonelier than an empty one?
title_zh: 为什么满屋人有时比空屋更孤独？

follow_ups.en: The loneliest room you stood in?
follow_ups.zh: 你待过最孤独的房间是哪种场合？

title_en: Stay when it's hard — or leave before bitterness wins?
title_zh: 难的时候留下，还是在恨意改写美好之前离开？

follow_ups.en: Can an ending still be love?
follow_ups.zh: 离开还可以是爱吗？

title_en: Happiness: a weekend place you visit once a year — keep going back?
title_zh: 快乐像每年只能去一次的周末胜地——你还会一直去吗？

follow_ups.en: Would Mondays get harder — or softer?
follow_ups.zh: 平常的周一会更难还是更温柔？
